description: This file defines a `CartFragment` class, which is a user interface component that displays shopping cart items with quantity controls, total cost, and removal options in an Android app. It manages list view rendering, item updates, and interactions with a repository.

classes.name: CartFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages the display and interaction of shopping cart items, including updating quantities and removing items.

classes.name: CartAdapter
classes.description: An inner class extending BaseAdapter to provide views for each cart item, supporting quantity adjustments and item removal.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view hierarchy, sets up the list view and total display, and populates data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the list adapter data and total cost display by fetching latest cart data.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of cart items and notifies that data has changed.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the cart.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the cart item at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the cart item at the specified position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or updates the view for a cart item, binding data and setting click listeners for quantity controls and removal.
